name: leantime-mcp
stderr:
Usage: leantime-mcp <url> --token <token> [options]

Options:
  --auth-method <method>    Authentication method (Bearer, ApiKey, Token, X-API-Key)
  --insecure               Skip SSL verification
  --protocol-version <ver> MCP protocol version
  --max-retries <num>      Maximum retry attempts (default: 3)
  --retry-delay <ms>       Base retry delay in milliseconds (default: 1000)
  --no-cache               Disable response caching

Environment Variables:
  LEANTIME_SERVER_URL      Leantime server URL (alternative to <url> argument)
  LEANTIME_API_TOKEN       API token for authentication (alternative to --token)

Examples:
  leantime-mcp https://leantime.example.com/mcp --token abc123
  leantime-mcp https://leantime.example.com/mcp --token abc123 --auth-method ApiKey
  LEANTIME_SERVER_URL=https://leantime.example.com/mcp LEANTIME_API_TOKEN=abc123 leantime-mcp
  leantime-mcp https://leantime.example.com/mcp --token abc123 --max-retries 5 --no-cache
